summary: Two KPI cards whose trends are negative, one with an icon and one without.
use: Metrics where a falling number is good or bad news, such as churn rate and response time.
spec: `<KpiCard title="Churn Rate" value="5.2" unit="%" trend={-1.8} icon={Activity} />`
`<KpiCard title="Response Time" value="1.4" unit="s" trend={-12.3} />` has no `icon`
